'''2013 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Matt Wehner DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Wehner]] at [[2013 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
